Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. As promised, I attached a lightweight starter for the Onramp Blueprint (MAP-style) that we typically use for 30-day pilots. This version is tailored toward a small clinical pilot and emphasizes a Week0 technical validation so your data/security team has a clear checklist.

What's included in the share:
- GDoc: Onramp Blueprint (editable) — proposed timeline, stakeholder lanes, acceptance criteria table (link below).
- Slides: Week0_Slides_stub.pptx — 3 slides for the kick-off (scope, owners, quick tech checklist).
- Spreadsheet: acceptance_criteria.xlsx — a two-tab template (functional + security).

Ask: Can you confirm the primary owners on your side for "Data Access" and "Clinical Ops" so we can populate the RACI? Also flag any hard no-go dates in June/July.

Quick notes on flow:
- Week0 (3–5 days): API connectivity, sample inference runs, SOC2 evidence exchange (we'll share a checklist and the specific artifacts you asked about).
- Week1: Controlled pilot with 1–2 clinics, acceptance gating on latency and accuracy sample set.
- Week2: Expand to additional clinics + throughput checks.
- Week3–4: Ramp plan and decision meeting (go/no-go).

Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1OnrampBlueprintStub (editable)
Slides: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/Week0SlidesStub

I've also dropped a short list of suggested internal owners in the doc. Marissa — can you add the Ops/CS owners on the right-hand lane?

If this looks ok, I'd like to schedule a 30-minute kick-off next week (proposed: Wed 6/9 or Thu 6/10).

Thanks,

Ava Chen

Ava —

Appreciate the fast turn. The materials look helpful. Couple quick asks from our side:

1) Timeline: we can do a 30-day pilot but need Week0 to be up to 7 days to let security perform an initial artifact review. Can you expand Week0 to be 7 days and call out exact artifacts (SOC2 section, network allowlist, data retention table)?

2) Can you confirm whether the pilot can run in a canary VPC (we prefer private deployment for the trial)? If so, we need a short runbook for creating temporary credentials and certs.

3) Procurement loop-in: I cc'd our procurement lead so she sees timeline and the doc. She may have a short PO/minor contract addendum question — will you be the contact for that?

Owners on our side: Oliver Grant (Clinical Sponsor), Procurement (procure@horizonhealth.ai). I will loop in Data Ops once we align on Week0 artifacts.

Proposed kick-off: Thu 6/10 at 10am ET if that works.

Best,
